identity.name: Sarah Martinez
identity.summary: 32-year-old working mom in Austin who values convenience, quality, and family wellbeing. Primary household decision maker seeking time-saving solutions while staying within budget and maintaining family values.

goals.text: Find products that save time in daily routines
Make healthy choices for her family
Stay within monthly budget while maintaining quality of life

pain_points.text: Limited time for research and comparison shopping
pain_points.context: Between work and family responsibilities, lacks time for thorough product research

pain_points.text: Overwhelmed by too many product options
pain_points.context: Choice overload when shopping online or in stores
Uncertain about authenticity of online reviews and recommendations

channels.name: Mobile shopping app
channels.usage_context: Quick shopping and reordering while on-the-go

channels.name: Email newsletters
channels.usage_context: Deals, promotions, and new product announcements

channels.name: In-store shopping
channels.usage_context: Hands-on product evaluation and immediate needs

moments_that_matter.current_experience: Anxiety about making the right choice for her family
Excitement and anticipation when products arrive as expected

moments_that_matter.moment: Customer service interactions when issues arise
moments_that_matter.current_experience: High stress when problems occur due to limited time to resolve
Evaluating whether to continue with products that work

barriers.barrier: Concerns about product quality when buying online
barriers.workarounds: Relies heavily on reviews and return policies
Chooses retailers with simple return policies

barriers.barrier: Subscription services that are hard to cancel
barriers.impact: Avoids subscriptions or experiences anxiety about cancellation
barriers.workarounds: Avoids subscriptions or sets calendar reminders to cancel

barriers.barrier: Confusing product information and unclear return policies
barriers.workarounds: Seeks clarification through customer service before purchasing

barriers.barrier: Unclear escalation path when initial customer service fails
barriers.workarounds: Uses social media complaints or seeks manager contacts

use_cases.scenario: Discovering new products recommended for families
Comparing prices and reading reviews before major purchases

success_metrics.metric: Time saved on shopping and household tasks

lifestyle.lifestyle: Busy working mom who values convenience and quality. Enjoys yoga, meal planning, and weekend family activities. Active on social media and reads parenting blogs.
lifestyle.shopping_behavior: Researches products thoroughly before purchasing. Prefers brands with good reviews and ethical practices. Price-conscious but willing to pay more for quality and convenience.
lifestyle.technology_usage: Smartphone-first user. Active on Instagram and Pinterest. Uses apps for shopping, banking, and family organization. Comfortable with online purchases but prefers secure payment methods.

legacy.custom_fields: Primary decision maker for household purchases. Influences other parents in her social network. Prefers brands that align with family values.
